        result1 = _decade_less(150, 10)
        assert result1 == 100
        
        # Test 2: Exactly a power of base
        result2 = _decade_less(100, 10)
        assert result2 == 10

        # Test 5: Negative exact power
        result5 = _decade_less(-100, 10)

        # Test 6: Base 2
